record: S4.7 of docs/roadmap/19-ai-strategy-improvement-wbs.md: why heuristic@87's VP did not improve. A diagnosis, not a promotion; written before any continuation is run

known.roleSplit: scripts/ai-role-margin.mjs on the attack games against heuristic@86's self-play on the same seeds: the candidate attacking changes the attacker VP margin by +0.90 +/- 1.63 a game (n 20), defending by +3.60 +/- 1.03 (n 20)
known.activeParts: meeting engagements: only approachAttack and arrivalRailForward act (theater allocation and hqBridge need the attacker of an attack engagement, defenderCut its defender)

branches.meeting: branches-meeting.jsonl (76): the first own Movement Segment of Game Turn 2 of the seat heuristic@87 played, in the 40 independent and 16 development meeting games, and of one seat (allied in even, axis in odd matches) in the 20 heuristic@87 self-play games of artifacts/ai-b5-v87/vs-self
branches.attacker: branches-attacker.jsonl (28): the attacker's first Movement Segment of Game Turn 2 in the 20 independent and 8 development attack games heuristic@87 attacked
branches.defender: branches-defender.jsonl (28): the defender's first Movement Segment of Game Turn 2 in the 20 independent and 8 development attack games heuristic@87 defended

horizons: T0+1 and the end of the game
measures: each variant - v86 for the subject, dice averaged per branch, mean and SE over branch points (scripts/ai-continue-compare.py --baseline v86): margin.vp at the end (VP is the primary measure); margin.objectives, Kill - Loss and margin.outOfTrace at the end reported
reading: a part lowers VP in a group if its margin.vp difference has mean + 2.1 SE < 0, raises it if mean - 2.1 SE > 0, and is not established otherwise
powerAnalysis: per-position VP SD about 2.5 (E5's continuations). Meeting, 76 branches: SE about 0.29, so a part with the batch's whole meeting effect (-0.8 a game) is found with probability about 0.75. Attacker and defender, 28 branches each: SE about 0.47; the defender's +3.6 is found, an attacker effect of +0.9 only with probability about 0.25.
